title: Worker Contract
description: Executive -> adapter. The unit of everything: dispatch, retry, racing, audit, and eventually distillation. If a task can't be written as a contract, the executive doesn't understand it yet -- request_human. Spec §4.

lane.description: Selected per contract by the executive, never by developer default.

model.description: WR only. Packaged lanes (W1/W2) pick internally -- their inner shell is opaque by construction.

context_refs.description: Paths/globs. Least privilege: workers get context_refs, not repositories.

capabilities.description: Capability tokens, not shell freedom. No token, no call.

budget.description: Checked BEFORE dispatch, not after. Hard stops beat apologetic overruns.

verification.description: V1 runs automatically per contract, before any model sees the artifact.
